title: Chapter 190 Fraud
content:
Chapter 190 Fraud

"Fuck, it's actually a mid-stage Immortal Emperor. I can't afford to offend him. I'm leaving."

"Fuck, you want to join in the fun, I'm leaving."

"Hey, wait for me!"

Seeing the strength of the middle-aged man in black, most people present were extremely shocked. Without hesitation, they chose to leave.

The reason is very simple.

Because there are not many mid-stage Immortal Emperors in the Wood Immortal Realm, and each of them is a terrifying existence.

For example, among the six major forces in the Wood Immortal Realm, there may not even be a mid-stage Immortal Emperor.

And now, with the emergence of special forces, any one of them is such a strong man.

The difference is immediately judged!

"Netherworld Palm!"

At this time, the middle-aged man in black from the Nether Palace suddenly shouted.

The next moment, a palm print mixed with terrifying power rushed towards Wanfeng in the distance, and the power was so great that ripples appeared in the surrounding space.

You know, this is the Immortal Realm, and the space is extremely stable.

If you want to break through the space, it is impossible to do it without the strength of the middle stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

"It's the Nether Palm!"

"I know who he is."

On the side, some people who did not choose to leave but stayed to continue watching suddenly spoke.

However, not everyone knew.

Sensing the doubts of the crowd, the person who spoke continued: "This person is the left protector of the Underworld Palace, Mingsheng."

"Mingsheng?"

Hearing this name, everyone was shocked and confused.

"I know him, but wasn't he still in the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm a hundred years ago?"

"Yes, he was still in the third level of the Immortal Emperor Realm a hundred years ago, but now his strength has reached the fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm. No wonder the Underworld Palace can become a special force."

For a while, everyone's heart was complicated.

The strength of the Underworld Palace has increased so quickly, and it will definitely take action at that time.

Just as everyone was pondering, a burst of sound suddenly sounded.

Boom!

Everyone looked at it suddenly, and their faces were horrified!

"What!"

It was seen that Mingsheng, who used the secret skills of the Nether Palace, not only did not gain any advantage, but was retreated thousands of feet away.

Seeing this scene, everyone had a guess in their hearts.

No way.

At this time, several obscure auras in the dark suddenly disappeared.

Noticing this, Wanfeng, who was standing in place, showed a sneer.

"Don't you just want to test my strength?"

"Yes, after tens of millions of years of sealing, my strength has indeed decreased a lot, but if you think you can deal with me like this, you can come and try."

As he said, Wanfeng pointed to Mingsheng, whose face was a little pale in the distance.

"In the future, don't look for this kind of trash anymore, otherwise I won't show mercy next time."

Suddenly, the whole void was completely quiet.

Everyone stared at Wanfeng in the void and confidently withdrew his hand, and then slowly returned to the deserted city.

"Lord Wan is invincible!"

"Lord Wan is awesome!"

In the deserted city, everyone cheered directly, with great momentum.

After all, they were all bought by Wan Feng with money, so they must be worth it.

In the void, Ming Sheng did not say a word, but his face was indeed very ugly.

What a shame, what a shame.

"Lord Wan, why don't you just kill that guy? Are we in the deserted city still afraid of his Ming Palace?"

Beside Wan Feng, Xun Heng ran over excitedly.

Seeing the scene just now, Xun Heng admired Wan Feng even more.

That was a strong man in the fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

And Wan Feng only used one blow to beat the other party without temper.

Hearing what Xun Heng said beside him, Wan Feng coughed lightly, "If I was just pretending, do you believe it?"

Tsk!

Hearing this, Xun Heng staggered and almost fell on the spot.

"An, Lord An, please don't scare me."

Xun Heng's face looked as ugly as he was excited just now.

Looking at Xun Heng's appearance, An Feng sighed, "What can I do? My strength has not fully recovered yet."

"But,"

An Feng patted Xun Heng's shoulder and said with a smile, "Don't worry, although I am not strong enough now and can't beat them, the strength of the deserted city is not weak."

As soon as these words came out, Xun Heng's sadness turned into joy.

"Lord An, do you have a backup plan?"

"Of course, have you forgotten what I said before?"

Xun Heng was a little excited, "Are you talking about the legendary city lord of our deserted city?"

An Feng nodded.

Seeing this, Xun Heng was shaking all over, that was excitement.

His intuition told him that the illusory master of this deserted city must be extraordinary.

"Lord An, where is he?"

"I don't know."

......

At this moment, the air was quiet.

Xun Heng still had a smile on his face, but it had frozen.

Bang!

Xun Heng fell to the ground.

"Fuck, little Hengzi! Little Hengzi!!"

"Don't play dead!"

"Sir, just treat me as dead. Wait until the city lord comes and wake me up."

After saying that, Xun Heng died on the spot.

On the spot, Wan Feng's mouth twitched slightly.

How did she know when the city lord would come to the fairyland.

Looking at Mingsheng who had not left in the void, Wan Feng's expression gradually became solemn.

She was not afraid of Mingsheng, but the person behind Mingsheng.

That Mingsheng was just a lead.

Although she tried her best to conceal her true strength in the previous attack, and said a few confusing words, she temporarily fooled them.

But it was not a long-term solution after all.

"Alas, I didn't expect that I would be targeted so soon."

Wanfeng shook her head.

She thought that she would not get into trouble if she relied on the reputation of the deserted city.

Her aura was not recognizable to anyone in the entire wood fairy world.

However, until a few years ago, the leader of the Immortal Sword Sect insisted on finding trouble.

She naturally had to take action.

But she hadn't fought for too long, so she still leaked a trace of her taboo aura.

"It should be that time."

Since then, she should have been targeted.

Buzz——

At this time, Wanfeng clenched her fists, and the immortal power in her body circulated wildly with the forbidden power.

The fourth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm!

It was more than enough to beat the kind of people like Mingsheng, but the rest were a bit difficult.

When I was at my peak, I was invincible in the entire Wood Immortal Realm, and I almost beat the Central Region.

Even my master Yan Lingyun said that I would definitely be on the Central Region Immortal Emperor List and be famous throughout the Immortal Realm.

Unfortunately, fate played tricks on me.

Not only did I fail to enter the Central Region, but I was sealed for tens of millions of years before I joined forces, and my strength declined.

Thinking of this, Wan Feng's expression became gloomy.

"These old immortals, when my strength recovers, I will visit them one by one."

"I will dig them out for you even if they die!"
